My introduction video is coming soon. Until then, get to know me through my
I am a software engineer with over five years of experience working on international projects,
from application development to reusable automation tools and performance analysis. I am now
exploring a more creative direction, bringing my analytical background and attention to detail
into the way I think about digital experiences.
I am available to help your team achieve meaningful results and create experiences that satisfy
users, with the highest possible quality. I approach challenges with curiosity, clear
communication and a commitment to seeing work through.
I use AI to explore ideas, accelerate routine work and improve my efficiency. I review its outputs
carefully and remain responsible for the decisions and quality of what I deliver.
I would welcome a conversation about how my experience, adaptability and creative perspective
Have a project, a possibility, or just a hello?
A reusable foundation for web and mobile automation, designed to support
Several web and mobile applications needed consistent validation of important user journeys,
with results that teams could understand and act on.
I developed and maintained a Java automation template with reusable scenarios, test data and
reports. I integrated execution into GitLab CI/CD, ran cross-browser and mobile checks, and
contributed to a container-based mobile testing setup.
The template supported several ENGIE projects. Automated reports helped teams inspect
A useful tool needs more than reliable code. Clear reports, reusable data and understandable
conventions help other people work confidently.
